title: Chick Webb as drummer and leader
summary: Chick had a very good ear, knew what he wanted, rehearsed the band and was serious about music.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, listen, I want to ask you about something. When like Chick was sitting in front of you on the drums. Was he then?
Well, so you could tell by the -- you know, like the guys used to say, you could tell by the way the Hump was breathing what he was listening to and how he felt about things, right?
I mean, you knew he was -- I mean, Chick had a very good ear, didn't he?
He had a very good ear.
So that he was -- you know, he heard every -- was he playing everything that you were playing? Was he falling right in with you, etcetera?
Yeah. Yeah, he knew what he wanted.
Yeah. He definitely did know what he wanted.
And he used to rehearse the band. He was a terrific guy, you know. And he knew what he wanted.
He was as serious about music as you were, I guess.
That's all he really lived for.
Oh, yeah. Yes, he was real serious
